prompt: Count how many Fridays fall between two fixed dates, inclusive of both endpoints.
explanation: A LocalDate loop with plusDays(1) visits every day, and the condition !d.isAfter(end) makes the range inclusive of the endpoint. getDayOfWeek() returns a DayOfWeek enum constant, compared with == like any enum. An arithmetic alternative uses TemporalAdjusters.nextOrSame(FRIDAY) plus ChronoUnit.WEEKS, but the loop is the clearest starting point.
hints: Loop with for (LocalDate d = start; !d.isAfter(end); d = d.plusDays(1)) -- isAfter keeps the end date inclusive.
Compare d.getDayOfWeek() == java.time.DayOfWeek.FRIDAY and count the matches.
